summary: Verified MinTrabajo public certificate button bug fix. The 'Generar certificado publico' / 'Regenerar certificado' button is now ALWAYS visible in the inspection detail toolbar with a dynamic label. Full E2E flow (open detail with existing cert, revoke, regenerate, close & reopen persistence, revoke via panel) all pass.

issues: Console warning: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen reader accessibility (Radix UI a11y). Non-blocking but should be addressed by wrapping title with VisuallyHidden or adding a DialogTitle.

action_items: (Optional / low-priority) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to any DialogContent lacking one to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: generateCertificate/revokeCertificate/copyCertUrl logic is clean; button label switches correctly via `certInfo ? 'Regenerar certificado' : 'Generar certificado publico'`.
openDetail correctly hydrates certInfo from `res.data.public_certificate_token` so panel persists across reopens.
Revoke inside panel properly clears certInfo => button label reverts.
MinTrabajoInspection.js is 420 lines - still manageable but approaching split threshold (>700).
seed_data_creation: Reused existing inspection 'Test Inspeccion Prueba' (insp_dfed18e8). Generated + revoked cert tokens during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for cert button visibility verified. On admin account there is 1 inspection (insp_dfed18e8) usable for future cert regression tests. Backend endpoints POST/DELETE /api/mintrabajo/inspections/{id}/certificate returned 200 during tests.
rca of the issue: Original bug: button was rendered inside `!certInfo ? (Generate) : (Revoke)` ternary, so once an inspection already had a public_certificate_token persisted in DB, openDetail loaded certInfo and the Generar button disappeared - user only saw Revocar. Fix: button rendered unconditionally with dynamic label based on certInfo, and Revocar moved inside the cert-info panel. Verified in browser: label='Regenerar certificado' when panel present, 'Generar certificado publico' after revoke.
